text: A confident answer is not the same as evidence. This assistant shows you the page.
Ask for an install command the docs do not contain. The fixed pipeline withholds the answer, instead of guessing.
The baseline invents a retired command, and cites nothing. That is the failure this demo makes visible.
Now, a question the docs can answer. In the fixed pipeline, every claim carries a citation: a version, a page, a block.
Open a citation, and the exact block is highlighted. You can check the answer, instead of trusting it.
The baseline answers from version two, silently. No version filter. No reranker. No abstention.
Eighty questions. Recall: zero point eight six five, to zero point nine four three. Citation coverage: zero point seven nine seven, to one. Version disambiguation: zero to one.
Every answer can be checked. Every missing answer can be refused. The code is in the repository.
